error: Kuch masla ho gaya. Dobara koshish karein.
crashAgain: Masla phir aa gaya. Is device par unsaved drafts mitane se shayad theek ho jaye. Aap ke saved records mehfooz hain.
crashBody: Tally Stick mein achanak masla aa gaya. Aap ke records mehfooz hain. App dobara load karne ke liye phir koshish karein.
clearDraftsRetry: Drafts mitayen aur phir koshish karein
requestFailed: Kuch masla ho gaya. Connection check kar ke dobara koshish karein.
unreachable: Abhi Tally Stick se rabta nahin ho raha. Connection check kar ke dobara koshish karein.

apiErrors.incorrectPassword: Aap ka mojooda password ghalat hai.
apiErrors.emailExists: Is email par pehle se account mojood hai.
apiErrors.resetExpired: Yeh reset link ghalat ya expire ho gaya hai. Naya link mangwayein.
apiErrors.versionConflict: Yeh record badal gaya hai. Save karne se pehle naya version load karein.
apiErrors.archived: Yeh hisaab archive ho chuka hai aur badla nahi ja sakta.
apiErrors.deleted: Yeh record delete ho chuka hai aur badla nahi ja sakta.
apiErrors.leaveGroups: Account delete karne se pehle tamam active groups chhorein.
apiErrors.reminderCooldown: Is hisaab ki yaad-dihani pehle bheji ja chuki hai. Baad mein koshish karein.
apiErrors.sessionExpired: Aap ka session expire ho gaya hai. Dobara sign in karein.
apiErrors.notAllowed: Aap ko yeh karne ki ijazat nahi hai.
apiErrors.notFound: Yeh cheez dastiyab nahi hai. Refresh karke dobara koshish karein.
apiErrors.conflict: Mojooda halat mein yeh kaam nahi ho sakta. Refresh karke dobara koshish karein.
apiErrors.invalidInput: Darj ki gayi maloomat check karke dobara koshish karein.
apiErrors.rateLimited: Bohat zyada darkhwastein hain. Baad mein koshish karein.
apiErrors.sessionChanged: Is darkhwast ke dauran aap ka account badal gaya. Dobara koshish karein.
apiErrors.inactiveMembers: Is record mein aisa member shamil hai jo ab is hisaab mein active nahi hai. Isay badla nahi ja sakta.
apiErrors.amountTooLarge: Yeh raqam bohat bari hai. Kam raqam darj karein.
apiErrors.invitationPending: Is shakhs ki dawat pehle hi pending hai. Dekhne ke liye group refresh karein.
apiErrors.objectionableContent: Is text mein aisi zabaan hai jis ki ijazat nahin. Ise badal kar dobara koshish karein.
